semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Niflon specializes in fluorochemical polymer materials which can be relevant for semiconductor packaging and encapsulation applications.
summary: Niflon Polymer Materials (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. manufactures fluorochemical polymer materials, including injection molded parts and masterbatches, which are essential for semiconductor packaging and assembly. The company adheres to high-quality standards and provides comprehensive after-sales service, making it a reliable partner for semiconductor manufacturers.

regional_presence.China: Niflon has a manufacturing presence in China and has obtained a license for direct export from overseas to China.
